events.summary: Chasing a Maquis ship, the new Intrepid-class Voyager is pulled 70,000 light-years by the Caretaker. Janeway destroys the array to protect the Ocampa, stranding a combined Starfleet–Maquis crew some 75 years from home.

events.title: Enterprise-D destroyed at Veridian III
events.summary: An attack by the Duras sisters triggers a warp-core breach. The saucer section crash-lands on Veridian III and the crew survives, but the ship is lost.

events.title: Kirk dies on Veridian III
events.summary: Drawn out of the Nexus by Picard, James T. Kirk helps stop Dr. Tolian Soran from destroying the Veridian star and dies in the attempt, 78 years after he was presumed lost.

events.title: Tal Shiar–Obsidian Order fleet destroyed
events.summary: A joint Romulan–Cardassian fleet attacks the Founders' homeworld in the Omarion Nebula, only to fall into a Jem'Hadar trap. The Obsidian Order is destroyed and the Tal Shiar badly crippled.

events.title: Klingons invade Cardassia, quit Khitomer
events.summary: Suspecting Dominion influence in a Cardassian civilian uprising, Gowron invades the Cardassian Union. When the Federation condemns the attack, the Klingons withdraw from the Khitomer Accords.

events.title: USS Enterprise-E launched
events.summary: The Sovereign-class Enterprise-E launches from the San Francisco Fleet Yards under Captain Picard, about a year after the loss of the Enterprise-D.

events.title: Antwerp bombing; coup attempt on Earth
events.summary: A Changeling bombs a Federation–Romulan conference in Antwerp. Admiral Leyton exploits the fear to stage a coup against President Jaresh-Inyo, which Sisko exposes.

events.title: Federation–Klingon War of 2372–73
events.summary: With the alliance broken, the Federation and the Klingon Empire fight a brief but bitter war, provoked by a Changeling impersonating General Martok.

events.title: DTI investigates the Defiant's time jump
events.summary: Agents Dulmur and Lucsly of the Department of Temporal Investigations — an agency that did not yet exist in the 2260s — debrief Sisko after the Defiant is thrown back to Space Station K-7 in 2268. Kirk's file lists seventeen temporal violations.

events.title: Bajor's Federation entry deferred
events.summary: Acting on a vision as Emissary, Sisko persuades Bajor not to join the Federation on the eve of its admission. Months later Bajor signs a non-aggression pact with the Dominion, which spares it from the coming war.

events.title: Cardassia joins the Dominion
events.summary: Gul Dukat brings the Cardassian Union into the Dominion and Jem'Hadar fleets pour through the wormhole. Facing the threat, the Klingons rejoin the Khitomer Accords.

events.title: Battle of Sector 001
events.summary: A second Borg cube reaches Earth and is destroyed with the Enterprise-E's help. A sphere escapes to 2063 to stop Zefram Cochrane's warp flight, and Picard's crew follows to protect first contact.

events.title: Dominion War begins
events.summary: Starfleet mines the wormhole's mouth to stop Dominion reinforcements. The Dominion and Cardassians seize Deep Space 9, and full-scale war breaks out with the Federation–Klingon alliance.

events.title: First contact with Species 8472
events.summary: Voyager finds the Borg losing a war against Species 8472 from fluidic space. Janeway forges a temporary alliance with the Collective to build a weapon that drives the invaders back.

events.title: Operation Return retakes Deep Space 9
events.summary: A Federation–Klingon fleet breaks the Dominion line, and the Prophets erase a Dominion reinforcement fleet inside the wormhole. The allies retake the station.

events.title: Krenim timeship's Year of Hell
events.summary: Annorax's Krenim weapon ship rewrites Delta Quadrant history in search of a perfect restoration of his people, battering Voyager for a year. When it is destroyed, the timeline resets and the year never happens.

events.title: Voyager contacts Starfleet
events.summary: Sent through an alien relay network, Voyager's EMH reaches the USS Prometheus. Starfleet learns the ship survived, and letters from home follow.

events.title: Section 31 exposed
events.summary: Julian Bashir is tested by Section 31, a covert agency claiming authority from the original Starfleet Charter. It later infects the Founders with a lethal disease.

events.title: Romulans join the Dominion War
events.summary: The assassination of Senator Vreenak, made to look like a Dominion act by Garak with Sisko's reluctant approval, brings the Romulan Star Empire into the war on the allied side.

events.title: Battle of Chin'toka; wormhole closes
events.summary: The allies win their first major foothold in Cardassian space, but a Pah-wraith kills Jadzia Dax and seals the Bajoran wormhole, cutting Bajor off from the Prophets for months.

events.title: Ba'ku relocation halted
events.summary: Picard defies a Federation–Son'a plan to harvest the rejuvenating metaphasic radiation of the Ba'ku planet by secretly relocating its people.

events.title: Breen attack Starfleet Headquarters
events.summary: The Breen Confederacy joins the Dominion and raids San Francisco, damaging Starfleet Headquarters. Their energy-dampening weapon then devastates an allied fleet at Chin'toka.

events.title: Damar leads a Cardassian rebellion
events.summary: Legate Damar turns against the Dominion and leads a Cardassian Liberation Front. When Cardassia rises, the Dominion begins exterminating its population.

events.title: Martok becomes Klingon Chancellor
events.summary: Worf kills Gowron in combat after the Chancellor's reckless strategy endangers the war effort and hands leadership of the Empire to General Martok.

events.title: Rom becomes Grand Nagus
events.summary: Zek retires and names Rom his successor, handing him a Ferengi Alliance newly reformed with rights for women and the first social programs.

events.title: Dominion War ends
events.summary: The allies besiege Cardassia Prime; Odo links with the Female Changeling and cures her of the disease, and the Dominion surrenders. Some 800 million Cardassians have died.

events.title: Sisko joins the Prophets
events.summary: Defeating Dukat and the Pah-wraiths in the Fire Caves, Benjamin Sisko passes into the wormhole to live among the Prophets.

events.title: Pathfinder opens regular contact with Voyager
events.summary: Reginald Barclay's Pathfinder Project uses a micro-wormhole to open a communication link with Voyager, later a regular monthly exchange.

events.title: Arbiter rules the Doctor an artist
events.summary: A Federation arbiter rules that Voyager's EMH may control his holonovel as its artist, though not yet that he is a person — a first step for holographic rights.

events.title: Voyager returns to Earth
events.summary: An Admiral Janeway from 2404 travels back to guide Voyager home through a Borg transwarp hub, crippling the network and infecting the Borg Queen with a neurolytic pathogen.

events.title: Shinzon's Reman coup on Romulus
events.summary: Shinzon, a Reman-raised clone of Picard, wipes out the Romulan Senate with thalaron radiation and seizes power, then plots to destroy all life on Earth before dying at the Bassen Rift.

events.title: Data dies aboard the Scimitar
events.summary: Data sacrifices himself to destroy Shinzon's thalaron weapon and save Picard; his memories live on in the prototype android B-4.

events.title: Riker takes command of USS Titan
events.summary: Newly promoted, Captain William Riker leaves the Enterprise-E to command the Luna-class Titan and leads a task force to the Romulan Neutral Zone as the Federation opens talks with the post-Shinzon government.

events.title: Starfleet begins the Romulan evacuation
events.summary: Warned that the Romulan star will go supernova, the Star Empire asks for help. Picard is promoted to admiral and leaves the Enterprise-E to lead a rescue armada meant to move 900 million Romulans.

events.title: Ferenginar begins joining the Federation
events.summary: Under Grand Nagus Rom, and with its trade routes battered by raids from the rogue ship Nova One, Ferenginar begins the formal process of joining the Federation, overseen by Captain Carol Freeman.

events.title: Voyager retired to the Fleet Museum
events.summary: The Cerritos prepares the famous USS Voyager for its final trip to Earth, where it is placed on display in the Starfleet Fleet Museum.
sources: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee (episode)

events.title: Quantum fissures erupt across the multiverse
events.summary: Rifts into parallel universes open across Federation space, triggered by a ship exploring the multiverse. The Cerritos, tasked with sealing them, ends up confronting the crisis at its source.

events.title: USS Protostar launched with proto-warp
events.summary: Starfleet's experimental Protostar, driven by a captured proto-star, departs San Francisco under Captain Chakotay; it is soon lost in the Delta Quadrant.

events.title: Living Construct attacks the fleet
events.summary: The Diviner's Living Construct, hidden aboard the Protostar, turns a gathering of Starfleet ships against each other. The Protostar is sacrificed to destroy it, and its young crew is admitted to Starfleet.

events.title: USS Voyager-A launched
events.summary: Vice Admiral Kathryn Janeway takes the new Voyager-A on its maiden voyage in search of the missing Chakotay; Chakotay later takes command.

events.title: Vau N'Akat time war averted
events.summary: Asencia, a Vau N'Akat agent from the future, tries to turn a temporal paradox into a weapon against the Federation. The Prodigy cadets return the Protostar to its proper place in time, and Voyager-A makes official first contact with the Vau N'Akat.

events.title: Synth attack on Mars
events.summary: On First Contact Day, synthetic workers — secretly subverted by the Zhat Vash — destroy the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards and the Romulan rescue armada, setting Mars ablaze and killing over 92,000 people.

events.title: Federation bans synthetic life
events.summary: The Federation outlaws the research, development and creation of synthetic lifeforms. Starfleet scales back and abandons the Romulan evacuation.

events.title: Picard resigns from Starfleet
events.summary: Admiral Picard quits in protest when Starfleet abandons the Romulan rescue, retiring to his family vineyard in France for fourteen years.

events.title: Romulan sun goes supernova
events.summary: The Romulan star explodes, destroying Romulus and Remus before Spock can contain it with red matter. The Star Empire collapses, and the Neutral Zone it guarded ceases to exist.
events.conflict: Star Trek (2009) says the supernova threatened the whole galaxy; PIC 'Remembrance' identifies the Romulan sun itself as the star. The name 'Hobus' for the exploding star is non-canon; the canonical Hobus system still exists in 3196.

events.title: Spock and Nero fall into the past
events.summary: The red-matter singularity swallows Spock's Jellyfish and Nero's Narada and throws them back in time into a new reality: Nero emerges in 2233 and Spock in 2258. Neither returns.

events.title: Romulan Free State rises
events.summary: From the wreckage of the Star Empire, the Tal Shiar-backed Romulan Free State emerges as the leading successor power, running the derelict Borg cube it calls the Artifact.

events.title: USS Titan-A launched
events.summary: The Neo-Constitution-class Titan-A enters service under Captain Liam Shaw; six years later it will be renamed Enterprise.

events.title: Coppelius standoff; synth ban lifted
events.summary: A Romulan fleet sent by the Zhat Vash to exterminate the synths of Coppelius withdraws after Picard persuades the synths to abandon their summons of machine super-intelligences and Starfleet arrives. The Federation lifts the synth ban after fourteen years.

events.title: Picard's mind moved to a synthetic body
events.summary: Picard dies of his brain abnormality and his consciousness is transferred into a synthetic 'golem' body. Data's consciousness, preserved in a quantum simulation, is ended at his request.

events.title: Q's Confederation timeline undone
events.summary: Q shifts Picard and his companions into an alternate 2401 ruled by the xenophobic Confederation of Earth. They travel to Los Angeles in 2024 to repair the divergence and restore history.

events.title: A new Borg collective joins the Federation
events.summary: A cooperative Borg collective, born in 2024 of Agnes Jurati and an alternate Borg Queen, reappears through a transwarp conduit and is granted provisional Federation membership to seal a dangerous spatial anomaly.

events.title: USS Voyager-B readied for launch
events.summary: A third Voyager, NCC-74656-B, is scheduled for launch as a contemporary of the Enterprise-F.

events.title: Changeling infiltration of Starfleet exposed
events.summary: Picard's crew uncovers renegade Changelings who have infiltrated Starfleet with new, undetectable shapeshifting, working with Vadic and the Shrike as agents of a larger Borg plot.

events.title: Enterprise-D restored for one last flight
events.summary: Geordi La Forge has spent two decades restoring the salvaged Enterprise-D at the Fleet Museum. Untouched by the Borg link, it is the only ship able to fly against the Collective on Frontier Day.

events.title: Frontier Day: Borg seize the fleet
events.summary: On the 250th Frontier Day, a Borg signal hidden in Starfleet's unified Fleet Formation links the fleet's young officers to the Collective and turns the ships against Earth. The recommissioned Enterprise-D's crew destroys the Borg Queen's cube.

events.title: Enterprise-F retired after Frontier Day
events.summary: Admiral Elizabeth Shelby's Odyssey-class flagship, slated for early decommissioning, is turned against Earth on Frontier Day; Shelby is killed by her own assimilated crew.

events.title: Borg Collective destroyed
events.summary: With the Queen and her cube destroyed over Jupiter, the Borg Collective is believed to be finished and the assimilated officers are freed.

events.title: Titan-A rechristened Enterprise-G
events.summary: A year after Frontier Day, the Neo-Constitution-class Titan-A is renamed USS Enterprise NCC-1701-G in honor of the Enterprise-D crew, with Captain Seven of Nine in command.

events.title: Admiral Janeway leaves 2404 to rewrite history
events.summary: In a future where Voyager took 23 years to return, an aging Admiral Janeway obtains a Klingon chronal deflector and travels back to 2378 to bring her crew home sooner, erasing her own timeline.

events.title: Barzan II joins the Federation
events.summary: Some time in the 25th century the Barzans, once too poor to join, become Federation members.

events.title: Time pod stolen from a 26th-century historian
events.summary: A 26th-century historian's time pod is stolen by the 22nd-century inventor Berlinghoff Rasmussen, who uses it to pose as a historian aboard the Enterprise-D in 2368 before Picard's crew sends him back.

events.title: Battle of Procyon V
events.summary: In a future shown to Archer by Daniels, a Federation fleet that counts Klingons and Xindi among its citizens defeats the Sphere-Builders at Procyon V and drives them back into their own realm.
events.conflict: Seen only in a vision from Daniels; the Sphere-Builders' spheres were destroyed in 2154 ('Zero Hour'), so whether this battle still happens is uncertain.

events.title: USS Enterprise-J in service
events.summary: The Universe-class USS Enterprise NCC-1701-J, a ship far larger than any 22nd-century vessel, takes part in the Battle of Procyon V.

events.title: Last known contact with the Q
events.summary: The Federation's last known contact with the Q Continuum happens around 2590; by the 32nd century the Q are a distant memory.

events.title: Last crossing to the mirror universe
events.summary: The final known crossing between the prime and mirror universes takes place; afterward the two realities drift apart and travel between them is thought impossible.

events.title: Kal Dano creates the Tox Uthat
events.summary: The scientist Kal Dano builds the Tox Uthat, a quantum phase inhibitor able to stop a star's fusion, and hides it on 22nd-century Risa to keep it from thieves. Two Vorgon criminals from his era hunt it in 2366.

events.title: Voyager's EMH adopts an aging program
events.summary: The Doctor from USS Voyager, still active three centuries after his ship came home, adds an aging subroutine to his matrix; he will still be teaching at Starfleet Academy in the 3190s.

events.title: The Cabal's future patron
events.summary: The faceless figure who directs the Suliban Cabal's operations in the Temporal Cold War is said to come from the 28th century.

events.title: Temporal Accord governs time travel
events.summary: An interstellar Temporal Accord permits time travel only for research and forbids changing history; Federation anthropologists from 2769 observe the building of the Great Pyramid under its rules.

events.title: Temporal Integrity Commission polices history
events.summary: The 29th-century Federation's Temporal Integrity Commission sends timeships such as the Aeon and the USS Relativity under Captain Braxton to detect and repair temporal incursions anywhere in history.

events.title: Temporal explosion destroys Sol (erased)
events.summary: In a timeline later erased, a 20th-century industrialist flies a stolen timeship to the 29th century and triggers an explosion that destroys the Sol system, prompting Braxton's mission to destroy Voyager in 2373.

events.title: The Temporal Wars
events.summary: For most of the 30th century the Federation fights a series of Temporal Wars to uphold the Temporal Accords against factions using time travel to remake history.
events.conflict: ENT's Daniels, a time-traveling agent from the 31st century, operates after the Temporal Wars are said to have ended in the 30th century.

events.title: Galactic dilithium begins to run out
events.summary: Known dilithium supplies begin drying up, and the Federation starts experimenting with alternative warp drive designs.

events.title: 31st-century temporal agents
events.summary: In Daniels's era time travel is so commonplace that quantum discriminators sit in school desks, and agents like him cross history to enforce the Temporal Accord against rival Cold War factions.

events.title: Khi'eth crashes in the Verubin Nebula
events.summary: The Kelpien research ship Khi'eth crashes on a dilithium planet deep in the Verubin Nebula. A rescue ship vanishes, and the only long-term survivor is Su'Kal, born there to a dying crew.

events.title: Starfleet Academy closes
events.summary: Starfleet Academy shuts its doors; it will not reopen for more than a century.

events.title: The Burn
events.summary: In an instant most dilithium in the galaxy goes inert and every active warp core explodes, killing millions. With warp travel crippled, the Federation begins to fragment and Qo'noS is devastated.
events.conflict: Booker (in 3188) and Vance (in 3189) both place it about 120 years earlier, putting it a year apart.

events.title: Burn devastates Qo'noS; Klingons scatter
events.summary: The Burn sets off matter–antimatter reactors across the Klingon homeworld and other worlds, rendering much of the Empire uninhabitable. The surviving Klingons scatter and the Great Houses dwindle to eight.

events.title: Doctor's backup revived in a Kyrian museum
events.summary: Seven centuries after Voyager's visit, a Kyrian curator reactivates a backup copy of its EMH. The Doctor corrects a warped history that cast Voyager as villains and helps bring peace between the Kyrians and Vaskans.

events.title: Emerald Chain rises after the Burn
events.summary: An Orion–Andorian mercantile syndicate grows in the chaos after the Burn into a de facto state, controlling dilithium and trade across much of the former Federation's space.

events.title: Earth leaves the Federation
events.summary: After the Burn, United Earth isolates itself and leaves the Federation. Federation headquarters and Starfleet move off Earth, and Titan breaks away.

events.title: Ni'Var leaves the Federation
events.summary: Ni'Var — Vulcan renamed after its people reunified with the Romulans — quits the Federation amid suspicion that its SB-19 research caused the Burn. No Federation ship visits it again for a century.

events.title: Betazed walls itself off
events.summary: Abandoned by the post-Burn Federation and ravaged by Venari Ral raids, the Betazoids raise a psionic wall around their star system; some thirty other worlds later shelter behind it, cut off from the galaxy for a century.

events.title: Temporal Accords ban all time travel
events.summary: Because of the Temporal Wars, the Temporal Accords are extended to outlaw time travel completely and time-travel technology is destroyed; by 3189 even the Federation has no way to send anyone through time.

events.title: Sahil begins a lonely Federation vigil
events.summary: Aditya Sahil becomes the lone keeper of a damaged Federation relay station and holds his post for some forty years, keeping his family's Federation flag — which, as a civilian, he may not raise — until Burnham commissions him in 3188.

events.title: Admiral Senna Tal calls believers to Earth
events.summary: On an obsolete Starfleet channel, Admiral Senna Tal broadcasts a call for anyone who still believes in the Federation to join him on Earth; the message later guides Burnham.

events.title: Burnham arrives in the 32nd century
events.summary: Michael Burnham emerges from the wormhole on Hima, sends the Red Angel suit back to fire the final signal, and spends a year as a courier with Cleveland Booker while waiting for Discovery.

events.title: Discovery reaches the 32nd century
events.summary: Discovery arrives a year after Burnham and finds a Federation shrunk from 350 member worlds to 38, run from a hidden headquarters. Admiral Vance welcomes it back into Starfleet with the registry NCC-1031-A.

events.title: Guardian of Forever found in hiding
events.summary: The Guardian of Forever, which fled the Temporal Wars, is found on Dannus V in the guise of 'Carl'. It sends the ailing Georgiou back to her own time.

events.title: Cause of the Burn discovered
events.summary: Discovery traces the Burn to Su'Kal, whose anguished cry resonated through the galaxy's dilithium; the nebula's dilithium world gives the Federation a way to rebuild warp travel.

events.title: Emerald Chain defeated at Federation HQ
events.summary: Osyraa's attempt to seize Discovery and Federation Headquarters fails. She is killed, and the Emerald Chain's grip on the region collapses.

events.title: Trill rejoins the Federation
events.summary: Trill becomes one of the first worlds to rejoin the Federation after the Burn's cause is solved.

events.title: Federation grows to 58 worlds
events.summary: With dilithium flowing again, 21 more worlds rejoin, Laira Rillak is elected President, and Starfleet Academy reopens after more than a century.

events.title: Dark Matter Anomaly destroys Kwejian
events.summary: A gravitational anomaly five light-years across rips through Kwejian and threatens worlds across the galaxy; it is later found to be an artificial mining device.

events.title: Ni'Var rejoins the Federation
events.summary: After a century apart, Ni'Var votes to rejoin the Federation under President T'Rina.

events.title: Discovery's AI Zora recognized as sentient
events.summary: The ship's computer, merged since 3189 with the ancient Sphere's archive, is judged a new sentient lifeform and enlisted as a Starfleet specialist.

events.title: First contact with Species 10-C
events.summary: Beyond the galactic barrier, a delegation of galactic powers led by Discovery reaches the extragalactic Species 10-C, whose mining had created the anomaly, and persuades them to stop.

events.title: United Earth rejoins the Federation
events.summary: Earth returns to the Federation it founded, a century after leaving it.

events.title: Red Directive hunt for Progenitor technology
events.summary: Under a classified Red Directive, Discovery follows clues hidden by 24th-century scientists toward the Progenitors' life-creating technology, racing the couriers Moll and L'ak and later the Breen.

events.title: Krenim chronophage traps Discovery in time
events.summary: A Krenim chronophage planted aboard sends Discovery skipping through its own past and future, including a 3218 in which the Breen have destroyed Federation Headquarters; the crew breaks free.

events.title: Breen Imperium torn by succession war
events.summary: The Breen Imperium, successor to the old Breen Confederacy, splits into warring factions over its leadership; rival Primarchs hunt the Progenitor technology, alarming Federation border worlds.

events.title: Progenitor technology left unclaimed
events.summary: Burnham reaches the Progenitors' interface inside a portal between binary black holes, refuses to use the power to create life, and the technology withdraws to await another finder. The Red Directive is closed and classified.

events.title: Kovich revealed as Agent Daniels
events.summary: The Federation's enigmatic intelligence chief Kovich tells Burnham his real name: Agent Daniels, the temporal agent who once served aboard Archer's Enterprise.

events.title: Starfleet Academy reopens in San Francisco
events.summary: The Academy welcomes its first San Francisco class in over a century under Chancellor Nahla Ake, with the USS Athena as training ship and Voyager's long-lived EMH on the faculty.
events.conflict: On-screen clues disagree: a personnel file and yearbook imply 3195–96, while the stardates convert to 3191–92, and DIS 'Kobayashi Maru' already shows the Academy reopened in 3190.

events.title: Betazed rejoins as the new Federation capital
events.summary: Betazed agrees to lower its psionic wall and rejoin the Federation on condition that it becomes the new Federation capital; the new seat of government is dedicated there in 3196.

events.title: Klingons settle New Qo'noS
events.summary: The Klingons, scattered since the Burn devastated Qo'noS, claim Faan Alpha as their new homeworld in a staged, bloodless 'conquest' arranged with the Federation, renaming it New Qo'noS.

events.title: Venari Ral ring the Federation with mines
events.summary: Nus Braka's Venari Ral seed Omega-47 mines — built around a synthetic Omega molecule stolen from Starbase J19-Alpha — around the core of Federation space.

events.title: Braka's show trial fails; Braka captured
events.summary: Nus Braka stages a broadcast 'Trial of the Federation' on the captured Sato Atrium while his Omega-47 mines hold worlds hostage. The USS Athena finds the atrium and seizes his mine-control frequency; Braka is arrested and discredited.

events.title: Discovery's final Red Directive mission
events.summary: Decades later, Admiral Burnham takes Discovery, restored to its original configuration, on one last mission: leaving the ship and its AI Zora in deep space to await someone called Craft.

events.title: Zora rescues Craft after a millennium
events.summary: After waiting about a thousand years, Discovery's AI Zora takes in Craft, a soldier adrift from a war between Alcor IV and the V'draysh, and sends him home in the ship's last shuttle.

incursions.title: Cold-start jump back seventy-one hours
incursions.summary: An emergency cold restart of the engines to escape a collapsing planet's orbit throws the Enterprise back 71 hours. Spock notes the method could be used for deliberate time travel.

incursions.title: Enterprise hurled back to 1969

legs.note: slingshot back to the moment before the jet encounter, to return Captain Christopher and the air police sergeant

incursions.method: black star gravity well; return by slingshot effect
incursions.summary: A black star's pull flings the Enterprise into 1969 Earth orbit, where it is spotted by the US Air Force. Spock times a slingshot around the Sun to drop the captured airmen back before their encounter and carry the ship home.

incursions.title: McCoy through the Guardian

legs.note: a delirious McCoy saves Edith Keeler, erasing the Federation
Kirk and Spock follow to undo the change

incursions.summary: An accidental cordrazine overdose sends McCoy leaping through the Guardian into Depression-era New York, where saving a pacifist's life lets Germany win the Second World War. Kirk and Spock follow and must let her die to restore history.
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

incursions.title: Historical research voyage to 1968
incursions.summary: The Enterprise travels to 1968 on an authorized historical survey and collides with Gary Seven's covert mission to sabotage an orbital weapons launch. The records they check afterward show events went exactly as they witnessed.

incursions.title: Landing party lost in Sarpeidon's past

to.tText: Sarpeidon's past: an era like Earth's 17th century (year unstated)

legs.note: placeholder t; the episode gives no year

incursions.summary: Hours before Beta Niobe goes nova, Kirk stumbles through the library's time portal into a witch-hunting past while Spock and McCoy land in an ice age 5,000 years back. All three return through the portal moments before the star explodes.
incursions.conflict: Kirk's destination year is never given; t=1700 is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Sarpeidon's population flees into history

legs.note: placeholder t for the whole population's dispersal into chosen eras
Mr. Atoz follows his family last, just before the nova

incursions.summary: Warned of their sun's imminent nova, Sarpeidon's entire population prepared their bodies with the atavachron and escaped into eras of their own past. The librarian Atoz is the last to go; Zarabeth was exiled to the ice age earlier by the same device.
incursions.conflict: No dates are given for any of the exodus eras; t is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Spock saves his own childhood

legs.note: historical survey; placeholder t
they return to a timeline in which Spock died as a child
Spock poses as his cousin Selek to guide his younger self through the kahs-wan

incursions.summary: Returning from a survey of Orion history, Spock finds a timeline in which he died at age seven. He goes back to Vulcan as 'cousin Selek' to ensure his younger self survives, at the cost of his pet sehlat I-Chaya.
incursions.conflict: The Orion-history destination is undated; t=-5000 is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Bounty sails back for humpbacks
incursions.summary: To answer a whale-song probe devastating Earth, Kirk's fugitive crew slingshots a captured Klingon Bird-of-Prey to 1986 and brings back two humpback whales plus the cetologist Gillian Taylor, who stays in the 23rd century.
sources: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

incursions.title: Tholian Web Defiant lands a century early

legs.note: the ship crossed both universes and about a century

incursions.summary: The USS Defiant, lost to interphase in Tholian space in 2268, was drawn through a rift into the mirror universe about a century earlier. Terran Empire officers seized it from the mirror Tholians in 2155.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
incursions.conflict: Arrival date inferred from its discovery in January 2155; the exact emergence time is unstated.

incursions.title: Manheim experiment repeats a moment

legs.note: loop: a few seconds replay for the Enterprise-D, the USS Lalo and the Coltar IV colony

incursions.summary: Dr. Paul Manheim's dimensional experiment on Vandor IV causes brief time skips in which a moment replays. Data seals the rift with antimatter to end the effect.

incursions.title: Picard's six-hours-future double
incursions.summary: The Enterprise-D recovers a shuttlepod carrying a dazed Picard from six hours in the future, after an energy vortex destroyed the ship in his timeline. The present Picard breaks the cycle by taking the ship into the vortex's center.

incursions.title: Enterprise-C through the Narendra rift

legs.note: its absence from the battle rewrites history into a Klingon war
returns to die at Narendra III, carrying the alternate Tasha Yar

incursions.summary: The Enterprise-C falls through a temporal rift 22 years forward, creating a timeline of Federation-Klingon war. Its crew goes back to certain death to restore history, taking along an alternate Tasha Yar whose capture in 2344 later produces Sela.

incursions.title: Vorgons pursue the Tox Uthat

legs.note: they leave empty-handed

incursions.summary: Two 27th-century Vorgon criminals travel to Risa to seize the Tox Uthat, a weapon able to halt a star's fusion. Picard destroys it and they return to their own time empty-handed.

incursions.title: Kal Dano hides his invention
incursions.summary: The Tox Uthat's inventor fled his own century and hid the device on 22nd-century Risa to keep it from criminals. It stayed hidden until 2366.
incursions.conflict: Described, not shown; exact years unstated.

incursions.title: Rasmussen's stolen time-pod

legs.note: the pod's unnamed 26th-century owner visits the 22nd century
Rasmussen steals the pod and poses as a 26th-century historian
the pod returns empty on its preset program

incursions.summary: A 22nd-century inventor steals a visiting 26th-century traveler's time-pod and arrives aboard the Enterprise-D posing as a future historian, collecting gadgets to 'invent' back home. The pod returns without him, and Rasmussen is stranded in 2368.
incursions.conflict: Rasmussen's exact home year in the 22nd century is not stated.

incursions.title: Enterprise-D caught in causality loop

legs.note: loop: the ship relives the same ~17 days until Data plants a clue
the USS Bozeman emerges 90 years after it entered the distortion

incursions.summary: A collision with the emerging USS Bozeman destroys the Enterprise-D over and over as a temporal distortion resets time. Data's buried subconscious message breaks the loop, and the Bozeman learns it has been lost for 90 years.

incursions.title: Devidians feed on 1893 San Francisco

legs.note: repeated trips; the Devidians harvest neural energy from the dying

incursions.summary: Phase-shifted aliens from Devidia II use a time portal to prey on cholera victims in 1893 San Francisco. The Enterprise-D destroys the portal to end the harvest.

incursions.title: Data's head in a Frisco cavern

legs.note: Data follows the Devidians
Picard, Riker, Troi, Crusher and La Forge follow to retrieve him
away team and a stowaway Samuel Clemens return; Picard stays behind
Clemens goes home
Picard returns last

incursions.summary: Data's 500-year-old head is dug up in San Francisco, and he duly travels back to 1893, where he is decapitated and his head is buried. His crewmates follow, meet the young Guinan, and bring back a curious Samuel Clemens, who returns home soon after.

incursions.title: Q replays Picard's reckless youth

legs.note: Picard's consciousness in his younger body, days before the Nausicaan fight
without the stabbing, he returns as an unremarkable junior lieutenant
he asks to go back and provokes the fight after all

incursions.summary: As Picard lies near death, Q lets him relive the day he was stabbed through the heart. Avoiding the fight produces a timid career as a lieutenant, so Picard chooses to take the blade again.
incursions.conflict: Q leaves it open whether any of this was real or a near-death experience.

incursions.title: Time runs backward at a warp breach

legs.note: local time reversal around the Enterprise and a Romulan warbird

incursions.method: temporal fragments around a Romulan artificial quantum singularity
incursions.summary: Returning by runabout, Picard's team finds the Enterprise frozen mid-way through a warp core breach, part of a zone of broken time created by alien life nesting in a Romulan singularity. Time runs backward to before the breach, and Picard severs the power beam behind it.

incursions.title: K'mtar comes back as Alexander

legs.note: presumed return

incursions.summary: An adult Alexander, whose father was murdered in his timeline, comes back under the name K'mtar to push his younger self toward the warrior path. Worf accepts his son as he is, leaving the future open.

incursions.title: Picard shifts across three eras

legs.note: repeated shifts among the three eras
Q shows Picard the moment life fails to form

incursions.summary: Q's final test sends Picard's consciousness among 2364, 2370 and a possible 2395, where anti-time spreading from the Devron system threatens to stop life from ever beginning on Earth. Three Enterprises collapse the anomaly together.

incursions.title: Two captains leave the Nexus

legs.note: Kirk is swept into the Nexus in 2293 and chooses to leave it in 2371
Picard exits the Nexus just before the Veridian star is destroyed

incursions.summary: Inside the timeless Nexus, Picard recruits a Kirk lost there since 2293, and both leave at a moment of their choosing, before Soran destroys the Veridian star. They stop the launch; Kirk dies on Veridian III.

incursions.title: Borg sphere strikes first contact

legs.note: Earth's history becomes an assimilated timeline in 2373

incursions.summary: Beaten at Sector 001, a Borg sphere opens a temporal vortex to the day before Zefram Cochrane's warp flight, to assimilate a defenseless Earth. The present instantly becomes a Borg world.

incursions.title: Enterprise-E follows to 2063

legs.note: shielded in the vortex's wake, the ship follows

incursions.summary: Protected by the vortex's wake, the Enterprise-E follows the Borg back, destroys the sphere, repels a Borg takeover of the ship, and ensures Cochrane's flight and the Vulcan landing happen on schedule.
incursions.conflict: Maj'el later cites the Cochrane flight as a predestination paradox involving Starfleet (PRO 'Who Saves the Saviors').

incursions.title: Sisko becomes Gabriel Bell

legs.note: Bell's death erases Starfleet above them in 2371

incursions.method: transporter malfunction (chroniton particles in the Defiant's cloak)
incursions.summary: A chroniton-tainted transport strands three officers in 2024 San Francisco, where Gabriel Bell is killed before the riots that bear his name. Sisko takes Bell's place and his photograph ends up in the history files.

incursions.title: Kira and O'Brien sweep the decades

legs.note: returns with the stranded officers

incursions.summary: With only enough chroniton particles for a handful of attempts, Kira and O'Brien beam down to 1930, 1967 and 2048 before finding their stranded crewmates in 2024.

incursions.title: O'Brien glimpses DS9's destruction

legs.note: sees the station destroyed by the Romulans
a future O'Brien replaces his dead present self

incursions.method: temporal displacement (radiation exposure plus a cloaked warbird's singularity)
incursions.summary: Radiation exposure near a cloaked Romulan warbird's singularity makes O'Brien skip hours into the future, where he sees himself die and the station explode. The O'Brien who remains is the one from a few hours later, who uses what he saw to prevent the attack.

incursions.title: Sisko anchored to Jake's future

legs.note: Jake's death breaks the link and Sisko snaps back to the accident

incursions.summary: Thrown out of time in an engineering accident, Sisko reappears at intervals of years, tethered to his son. An aged Jake ends his own life to cut the tether, returning his father to the moment of the accident.

incursions.title: Ferengi crash at Roswell

legs.note: kemocite reaction with an atomic test blast

incursions.method: warp field time warp (sabotaged warp core, kemocite)
incursions.summary: Sabotage flings Quark's shuttle from its trip to Earth into 1947, making its passengers the aliens of the Roswell incident. They escape by pairing their kemocite with a nuclear test blast.

incursions.title: Prophets send Akorem Laan forward

legs.note: returned to finish his poem

incursions.summary: A legendary Bajoran poet lost two centuries earlier emerges from the wormhole claiming to be the Emissary. Sisko asks the Prophets to send him home, where he completes the poem that history already knew.

incursions.title: Defiant to Space Station K-7

legs.note: carried by the Orb of Time

incursions.summary: Disguised as a human trader, Arne Darvin hijacks the Orb of Time aboard the Defiant to reach 2268 and plant a tribble bomb meant for Kirk. Sisko's crew trails him through the original Enterprise's tribble crisis and removes the bomb.

incursions.title: Defiant's descendants on Gaia

legs.note: in the original loop the Defiant crashes and its crew founds Gaia

incursions.summary: A barrier planet's energy would throw the Defiant 200 years back, where its stranded crew would found a colony of 8,000 descendants. An elder Odo alters the escape course, the ship gets through safely, and Gaia never exists.

incursions.title: Kira visits her mother's Terok Nor
incursions.summary: Kira uses the Orb of Time to see whether Dukat's claims about her mother, Meru, are true. She finds them true, nearly assassinates both, and relents.
sources: Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night (episode)

incursions.title: Molly O'Brien lost three centuries

legs.note: a feral 18-year-old Molly is retrieved
her parents send her back, arriving just after her younger self
older Molly sends young Molly home and vanishes

incursions.summary: Eight-year-old Molly falls through an ancient time portal and is recovered as a feral adult. Sent back through, the older Molly pushes her younger self home and erases her own life.

incursions.title: Cusak's distress call three years displaced

legs.note: time-displaced communication, not travel
the Defiant's replies reach her own time

incursions.summary: The Defiant's crew talks for days with a stranded captain, not realizing that their signals are crossing three years. They arrive to find she died long ago.

incursions.title: Voyager caught in a singularity's echo

legs.note: event-horizon time distortion produces a duplicate Voyager image

incursions.method: event horizon of a quantum singularity
incursions.summary: Trapped behind a quantum singularity's event horizon, Voyager chases a mirror image of itself that is really a time-shifted reflection. Janeway and Torres find the real exit.
incursions.conflict: Memory Alpha lists this as a short backward jump; on screen it plays as time and space distortion rather than clear travel.

incursions.title: Janeway and Paris on doomsday's eve

legs.note: their rescue attempt caused the explosion; closing the fracture erases the whole episode

incursions.summary: Subspace fractures carry Janeway and Paris to the day before a polaric explosion destroys a planet. It emerges that Voyager's own rescue caused the blast, and collapsing the fracture resets events so it never happens.

incursions.title: Micro-wormhole to a 2351 Romulan

legs.note: test cylinder
Telek R'Mor beamed aboard Voyager
R'Mor returned to his own time with the crew's messages

incursions.summary: A micro-wormhole to the Alpha Quadrant links Voyager with a Romulan scientist who turns out to live 20 years in the past. He agrees to deliver the crew's letters in 2371, but dies in 2367 before he can.

incursions.title: Quinn hides Voyager at the Big Bang

legs.note: Quinn hides Voyager at the beginning of the universe
Q pursues

incursions.summary: The Q prisoner Quinn, seeking asylum, hides Voyager at the Big Bang during a chase with Q. The pursuit ends with an asylum hearing aboard ship.
incursions.conflict: The universe's age is never stated on screen; t=-1.38e10 uses the real-world estimate.

incursions.title: Braxton's Aeon attacks Voyager

legs.note: Braxton tries to destroy Voyager, blaming it for a future explosion
the Aeon crashes on Earth; Henry Starling finds it and Braxton lives as a vagrant for 30 years

incursions.summary: A 29th-century timeship attacks Voyager to prevent a disaster Braxton blames on it. Both ships fall into the rift, the Aeon crashes in 1967, and Henry Starling builds his computer empire from its technology.

incursions.title: Voyager stranded in 1996 Los Angeles

legs.note: a Braxton from the repaired timeline comes to collect Voyager
returned to the Delta Quadrant, not the Alpha

incursions.summary: Voyager arrives in 1996 and must stop Starling from flying the stolen timeship to the future, where it would cause the explosion Braxton feared. Once history is fixed, an unaware Braxton returns them to 2373 in the Delta Quadrant.

incursions.title: Kes lives her life backward

legs.note: year unstated; estimated
before she joined Voyager
the Doctor's chroniton-free chamber pulls her back

incursions.method: chroniton radiation reactivated by a bio-temporal chamber
incursions.summary: In a future where she married Tom Paris, a dying Kes starts jumping backward through her own life, a delayed effect of Krenim chroniton radiation. Knowledge from the jumps lets the Doctor stabilize her, and she wakes in 2373 knowing what will happen.
incursions.conflict: Several jumps are dated only relatively on screen; those legs use estimated t values (see leg notes).

incursions.title: Krenim weapon ship erases itself

to.tText: the 2170s (before the weapon ship was built)

legs.note: the ship's destruction unmakes two centuries of its temporal incursions; Voyager resets to March 16, 2374

incursions.summary: For two centuries Annorax's weapon ship erased whole species from history to rebuild the Krenim Imperium and bring back his wife. When Voyager rams it, the ship erases itself: the incursions never happened, and Voyager's year of hell never begins.

incursions.title: Kim rewrites Voyager's fatal crash

legs.note: corrected slipstream phase variance and a message sent via Borg temporal transmitter, not travel

incursions.summary: Fifteen years after a slipstream accident killed everyone aboard Voyager, Kim and Chakotay steal the Delta Flyer and send corrective data back to Seven of Nine. The ship survives, and their future is erased.

incursions.title: Seven hunts a saboteur through time

legs.note: Seven is recruited at the moment Voyager explodes
Seven searches for the planted device
an older, deranged Braxton
a different Seven and Janeway taken aboard the Relativity
Janeway pursues the saboteur
Janeway returns with the arrested Braxton
Janeway and Seven sent home before the explosion

incursions.summary: The 29th-century timeship Relativity recruits Seven to find who planted a temporal disruptor aboard Voyager. The culprit is a future Braxton taking revenge on Janeway, and three versions of Braxton are involved before the device is removed.

incursions.title: Aged Kes returns for her youth

legs.note: an older, embittered Kes sabotages Voyager for the Vidiians
implied: she is next seen in 2376, being sent home to Ocampa

incursions.method: psychokinetic power boosted by Voyager's warp core
incursions.summary: An older, embittered Kes uses Voyager's warp core to go back to 2371 and take her younger self home. A holo-message recorded by the young Kes warns Janeway in time and later reminds the older Kes who she was.

incursions.title: Voyager splintered into temporal fragments

legs.note: Kim, Torres and Ayala cross fragments
Seven of Nine crosses fragments
adult Icheb and Naomi Wildman from a 2394 fragment

incursions.method: temporal rift (ship fractured into time zones)
incursions.summary: A temporal rift splits Voyager into fragments from different years. Chakotay, the only one inoculated against the shift, crosses them with a 2371 Janeway to set a chroniton torpedo, while Seska and the Kazon hold one section.

incursions.title: Admiral Janeway brings Voyager home early

legs.note: she dies in the Borg Queen's unicomplex

incursions.summary: In a 2404 where Voyager took 23 years to get home, Admiral Janeway buys a chrono deflector and returns to 2378 with future armor and weapons. She gets Voyager home through a Borg transwarp hub and cripples the Collective.

incursions.title: Q junior traps Voyager in a loop

legs.note: loop: the same 30 seconds repeat

incursions.summary: Q's delinquent son amuses himself by trapping Voyager's crew in a 30-second causality loop, one of the pranks that lead his father to strip his powers for a probation.

incursions.title: Future Guy briefs the Cabal

legs.note: orders the Paraagan II frame-up
tells Archer the Xindi are behind the attack on Earth
orders Silik to stow away for 1944

incursions.method: partial materialization through a Suliban temporal chamber (communication only)
incursions.summary: The unseen benefactor of the Suliban Cabal speaks from the 28th century through a temporal chamber, sending orders and technology. He cannot travel physically, and his identity is never revealed.
incursions.conflict: The 28th-century origin rests on Archer's line in 'Storm Front, Part II'.

incursions.title: Daniels embedded aboard NX-01

legs.note: posing as a steward from launch

incursions.summary: A 31st-century temporal agent serves as a crewman aboard Earth's first warp-five ship to watch the Temporal Cold War. He reveals himself to Archer when the Suliban come for his temporal observatory.

incursions.title: Time tourists watch the pyramids rise

legs.note: shown to Archer as an example of sanctioned observation

incursions.summary: Daniels tells Archer that time-traveling anthropologists from 2769 watched the Great Pyramids being built. He offers it as an example of sanctioned travel under the Temporal Accords.
incursions.conflict: The pyramid-building date (c. 2560 BCE) is real-world history, not stated in dialogue.

incursions.title: Daniels hides Archer in the 31st century

legs.note: a private briefing out of the Suliban's reach
Archer's absence from history leaves the 31st century in ruins
retrieved through a Suliban temporal chamber

incursions.summary: To shield him from the Cabal, Daniels pulls Archer into the 31st century, but Archer's absence from the 22nd century wipes Daniels' era out. Archer reaches his crew from the ruins, and a device planted in the Cabal's temporal chamber brings him home.
incursions.conflict: Memory Alpha's time travel table places the ten-months-earlier stop in 2152; ten months before February 2152 is April 2151.

incursions.title: 31st-century pod adrift in 2152

legs.note: wrecked with its human pilot dead
its temporal radiation throws Tucker and Reed into repeating distortions
the reactivated beacon calls it home

incursions.summary: Enterprise finds a derelict timeship, bigger inside than out, with a human pilot, and fights off both Suliban and Tholians who want it. When Tucker reactivates its temporal beacon, the pod vanishes back to its own era.

incursions.title: Xindi-Reptilians brew a plague in 2004

legs.note: Archer brings Commander Damron back as a prisoner

incursions.summary: Xindi-Reptilians go back to 2004 Detroit to cultivate a bio-weapon from kidnapped humans, meant to wipe out humanity before it reached space. Archer and T'Pol wreck the lab.

incursions.title: Archer and T'Pol to Detroit
incursions.summary: Unable to go himself, Daniels sends Archer and T'Pol to 2004 to stop the Reptilians' bio-weapon lab. They destroy it with help from a reluctant local accomplice.

incursions.title: Archer sees the Battle of Procyon V

legs.note: aboard the USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-J)

incursions.summary: Daniels takes Archer to the Enterprise-J to show a 26th-century Federation fighting the Sphere-Builders at Procyon V. The point is to persuade him not to die destroying the Xindi weapon.

incursions.title: Lorian's Enterprise meets its past

legs.note: in Lorian's history the corridor throws Enterprise back 117 years
loop closes: the ship lives 117 years forward to meet itself at the corridor

incursions.method: subspace corridor destabilized by the impulse wake
incursions.summary: At the corridor, Archer meets a second Enterprise commanded by Lorian, Tucker and T'Pol's son, whose crew descends from an Enterprise this same transit threw back to 2037. Archer's ship gets through safely and Lorian's never emerges.
incursions.conflict: The ending leaves open whether Lorian's ship was erased; Archer and T'Pol disagree.

incursions.title: Archer's lost dozen years undone

legs.note: loop/collapse: parasites existing across Archer's timeline are destroyed in 2165, erasing the 2153-2165 future

incursions.summary: Interspatial parasites leave Archer unable to form new memories, and without his command Earth falls to the Xindi by 2165. Because the parasites exist across his whole timeline, destroying them in 2165 erases that future back to the moment of infection.

incursions.title: Archer glimpses the Federation's founding
incursions.summary: Daniels takes Archer to watch the Federation Charter being signed in 2161, to show him how central he is to history.

incursions.title: Na'kuhl flee into Nazi 1944

legs.note: one-way stealth time travel

incursions.method: stealth time travel (one-way); temporal conduit under construction
incursions.summary: Nearly captured by the temporal agents, Vosk's Na'kuhl escape to a 1944 already bent by many factions' incursions. They ally with the Nazis to build a conduit home, from which they would start the Temporal War.

incursions.title: Enterprise sent to stop Vosk

legs.note: Daniels' last intervention
the conduit's destruction resets the timeline

incursions.summary: Daniels, dying from the chaos of the Temporal War, sends Enterprise into the altered 1944. With the American resistance and a self-serving Silik, Archer destroys the Na'kuhl compound as Vosk enters the conduit, and history resets.

incursions.title: Na'kuhl try to stop Suliban sentience

to.tText: before the Suliban became sentient (date unstated)

legs.note: placeholder t; temporal agents intervened

incursions.summary: Vosk says that his people once went back to keep the Suliban from ever becoming sentient, and that opposing temporal agents stopped them.
incursions.conflict: Described, not shown; the destination date is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Narada falls into 2233

legs.note: Nero destroys the USS Kelvin and the Kelvin timeline begins
Spock's Jellyfish arrives 25 years later and is captured

incursions.summary: Spock's red-matter black hole, meant to swallow the Hobus supernova, pulls in Nero's mining ship and deposits it in 2233, where its attack on the USS Kelvin splits off a new reality. Spock emerges 25 years later into Nero's hands.

incursions.title: Kelvin-timeline soldier crosses into prime

legs.note: crossed both time and dimensions

incursions.summary: Lieutenant Commander Yor, a Betelgeusian officer from the Kelvin reality, crossed both universes and centuries as a 'time soldier', and the strain was incurable. Kovich cites his case, which ended in euthanasia, when Georgiou falls ill.
incursions.conflict: Arrival year only bounded (post-Temporal Accord, pre-3189); t=3100 is an estimate.

incursions.title: Mudd's thirty-minute time loop

legs.note: loop: ~30 minutes repeated dozens of times

incursions.summary: Harry Mudd uses a time crystal device to loop half an hour again and again, trying to seize Discovery's spore drive for the Klingons. Stamets, who stays aware across the resets, helps the crew outwit him.
sources: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad (episode)

incursions.title: Discovery overshoots by nine months
incursions.summary: Leaving the mirror universe, Discovery's spore jump returns it home nine months after it vanished, by which point the Klingons are winning the war.
sources: The War Without, The War Within (episode)

incursions.title: Gabrielle Burnham escapes 950 years forward

legs.note: meant to jump one hour; tethered thereafter to the future

incursions.summary: During the Klingon raid on Doctari Alpha, Michael's mother activates the Daedalus suit to jump an hour but lands 950 years ahead, in a galaxy Control has emptied of life. The suit anchors her there, and every trip back pulls her forward again.
incursions.conflict: MA's time travel table says only '32nd century'; the 950-year figure gives c. 3186.

incursions.title: Red Angel rescues a 2053 congregation

legs.note: relocates a church and its people to Terralysium, 51,000 light years away

incursions.summary: To test whether time could be changed, the Red Angel moves a Richmond, Indiana, church congregation out of World War III to the distant planet Terralysium. Their descendants still worship the angel when Discovery arrives in 2257.

incursions.title: Red Angel appears to young Spock

legs.note: tells Spock where the runaway Michael is

incursions.summary: Gabrielle jumps to Vulcan when young Michael runs away, and shows the boy Spock where to find her. The visions stay with Spock into adulthood.
incursions.conflict: The year of Michael's runaway is not given; t is an estimate.

incursions.title: Red Angel trapped on Essof IV

legs.note: one of 840 recorded jumps; many 2257 sightings
yanked back through the wormhole when the containment field fails

incursions.summary: Discovery and Section 31 bait a trap with Michael's life and catch the Red Angel on Essof IV, revealing Michael's mother. When Control attacks the base, the suit's tether drags Gabrielle back to the future.

incursions.title: Probe returns five centuries older

legs.note: launched into a temporal rift left by the Red Angel
comes back modified, hunting for data

incursions.summary: A Discovery probe that Pike launches into a temporal rift near Kaminar comes back with a core aged 500 years, rebuilt by someone in the future. It attacks Pike's shuttle and later infects Airiam on Control's behalf.

incursions.title: Pike foresees his 2266 accident

legs.note: a vision through the crystal, not physical travel

incursions.summary: To claim a Boreth time crystal, Pike touches it and sees the accident that will cripple him saving cadets. He takes the crystal anyway, accepting that future.

incursions.title: Michael plants the red bursts

legs.note: first burst
second burst
third burst; stops a Ba'ul culling
fourth burst
fifth burst
returns to open the wormhole

incursions.method: Red Angel suit (second suit, Boreth crystal)
incursions.summary: In mid-battle, Michael uses a new Red Angel suit to go back and set the red bursts that led Discovery to everything it needed, from the Hiawatha to Po on Xahea. The signals were her doing all along.
incursions.conflict: Burst times are placed by their episodes' order; exact dates are unstated (MA: 'various points throughout 2257').

incursions.title: Discovery follows Burnham to 3188

legs.note: Michael in the suit
Discovery and crew

incursions.summary: To keep the Sphere data out of Control's reach, Michael opens a wormhole and leads Discovery 930 years into the future. She lands a year ahead of the ship, and both stay in the post-Burn 32nd century.

incursions.title: Suit sends the seventh signal home

legs.note: a signal sent back in time; the suit then self-destructs

incursions.summary: After arriving, Burnham has the suit send a final signal back to Spock, letting her friends know the jump worked, and then destroy itself.

incursions.title: Guardian sends Georgiou home and on

legs.note: the Guardian's test: a second chance in her own universe
only seconds pass on Dannus V
sent to an era she can survive; she resurfaces running a station

incursions.summary: Dying from being displaced in both time and universe, Georgiou walks through the Guardian's door and relives months as Emperor in 2255. She passes its test and is sent to a period she can live in, which the Section 31 film puts in the early 24th century.
incursions.conflict: Destination year given only as 'early 24th century' (film); t=2320 is an estimate.

incursions.title: Time bug unmoors Discovery

legs.note: Burnham and Rayner only; the future ship in ruins

incursions.summary: A Krenim chronophage planted by Moll and L'ak makes Discovery lurch among points in its own history, from the Klingon war to a ruined 33rd century. Burnham, Rayner and Stamets, the only ones aware of it, find and remove the bug.

incursions.title: Kovich unmasked as Agent Daniels

legs.note: not shown on screen; he says he has lived 'many years and many lives'

incursions.summary: The Federation official known as Kovich tells Burnham that he is the temporal agent Daniels, 'of the Enterprise and other places', and keeps artifacts from several eras in his office.
incursions.conflict: How a 31st-century agent came to 3189 (travel or simply longevity) is unstated.

incursions.title: Future Pike shows the alternate 2266

legs.note: an older Pike from the future he tries to avoid
Pike lives through the Balance of Terror crisis in command

incursions.summary: An older Pike carrying a Boreth crystal shows his younger self what happens if he dodges his fated accident: war with the Romulans and Spock's death. Pike accepts the path the crystal showed him.

incursions.title: La'An to 2022 Toronto

legs.note: a mortally wounded temporal agent appears aboard and hands La'An his device
La'An alone remembers the prime history in a timeline with no Federation
with the alternate timeline's Captain Kirk
returns after Khan is saved; Kirk has died
Agent Ymalay of the DTI thanks her and swears her to secrecy

incursions.summary: After a temporal agent dies in her arms, La'An lands in a timeline with no Federation and goes to 2022 with that timeline's Kirk to find what broke history. She has to keep a Romulan agent from killing the boy Khan, preserving her own notorious ancestor.
incursions.conflict: The agents' home era is never given; t=2380 is a placeholder for 'the future'.

incursions.title: Romulan agent stalks the young Khan

legs.note: sent to kill Khan; stranded 30 years as his rise keeps being pushed back

incursions.summary: Sera, a surgically disguised Romulan operative, was sent to stop Khan's rise and so the Federation's future. Rival incursions kept shifting Khan's timeline, and she waited 30 years for her chance in 2022.
incursions.conflict: Explains the shift of the Eugenics Wars from the 1990s (TOS) into the 21st century. Origin date is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Temporal Wars fought over Khan

legs.note: many factions' incursions; the Eugenics Wars slide into the 21st century

incursions.summary: According to Sera, whole Temporal Wars were fought over whether Khan would exist. Their net effect was to push his rise and the Eugenics Wars from the 20th century into the 21st.
incursions.conflict: Reconciles TOS 'Space Seed' (Eugenics Wars in the 1990s) with SNW's later dating; dates are placeholders.

incursions.title: Boimler and Mariner meet Pike's crew

legs.note: Boimler pulled through the portal
Mariner leaps in after him
portal re-energized with horonium

incursions.summary: A dormant portal on Krulmuth-B, first surveyed by Pike's Enterprise, pulls Ensign Boimler back 120 years into his heroes' era, and Mariner jumps after him. Pike's crew recharges the portal to send them home.
incursions.conflict: The brief associated this with the Orb of Time, but MA shows only the Krulmuth-B portal; no Orb appears.

incursions.title: Enterprise stranded with the dinosaurs

legs.note: a category 10 interstellar squall displaces the ship
rides the blast wave of the Dol'drm homeworld's destruction

incursions.summary: A space storm throws the Enterprise back 65 million years, onto a Cretaceous Earth and into a war between Mars' inhabitants and the planet Dol'drm. The ship rides home on the blast that destroys Dol'drm, whose debris formed the asteroid belt and caused the Chicxulub impact.
incursions.conflict: Memory Alpha's time travel table says 2261; the episode page gives stardate 2491.5 (2262).

incursions.title: Two Uhuras swap across a year

legs.note: entangled Uhuras switch timestreams
time rewinds and each returns; only the two Uhuras remember

incursions.method: white hole / black hole pair (a space entity's birth pulses)
incursions.summary: Energy from a white hole entangles the Uhura of Pike's final year with herself a year later on Kirk's Enterprise, and the two briefly switch places. In the future Scotty has died, but when the pulses turn out to be a cosmic being's birth, time rewinds and he lives.
incursions.conflict: MA's page is a stub (dates from its sidebar); mechanics were checked against published recaps.

incursions.title: Q rewrites 2401 as the Confederation

legs.note: a timeline shift, not travel: Q moves the crew into the history he changed

incursions.summary: In the middle of a Borg standoff, Q strands Picard's crew in a fascist 2401 ruled by the Confederation of Earth, the result of his own meddling in the past. Only they remember the real history.

incursions.title: Q tampers with 2024

legs.note: his deal with Adam Soong derails the Europa mission

incursions.summary: The dying Q goes to 2024 and gives Adam Soong a temporary cure for his daughter's condition in return for sabotaging Renée Picard's Europa mission. That creates the Confederation timeline as a test for Picard.
incursions.conflict: Q's point of departure is not shown; 2401 is assumed.

incursions.title: La Sirena slingshots to 2024

legs.note: with the Confederation's Borg Queen aboard
Q sends Picard, Seven and Raffi home; Rios and the Jurati-Queen stay

incursions.method: slingshot effect (Borg Queen-assisted); return by Q
incursions.summary: The crew slingshot a captured La Sirena into 2024 to protect Renée Picard's mission. Rios stays in the past with a new family, Jurati merges with the Borg Queen, and Q returns the others to the moment they left.

incursions.title: Traveler Wesley recruits Kore

legs.note: origin assumed; Travelers move through space and time

incursions.summary: Wesley Crusher, now a Traveler, visits 2024 to offer Kore Soong a place among the beings who guard time and space, and she accepts.
incursions.conflict: Wesley's departure time is unknown; the leg's origin is a placeholder.

incursions.title: USS Bakersfield caught in a loop

legs.note: loop; its distress call keeps interrupting itself

incursions.summary: The Cerritos answers a distress call from the USS Bakersfield, which is stuck in a causality loop.

incursions.title: Protostar falls to 2436 Solum

legs.note: a wormhole carries Chakotay's ship into the Vau N'Akat future
original history: Chakotay sends the ship back empty on autopilot

incursions.summary: On its maiden mission the Protostar was drawn through a wormhole to 2436, where the Vau N'Akat, blaming the Federation for their civil war, put a living weapon aboard. Chakotay sent the ship back through time, where it lay buried on Tars Lamora until the kids found it.
incursions.conflict: Chakotay's original autopilot launch was later superseded by the altered and then repaired history (see protostar-rescue-paradox, ouroboros).

incursions.title: Diviner and Vindicator chase the Protostar

legs.note: the Diviner and his Drednok
the Vindicator, a future Asencia, infiltrates Starfleet

incursions.summary: A hundred Vau N'Akat agents follow the ship into the anomaly, and only two survive. The Diviner (a future Ilthuran) builds the Tars Lamora mining prison to search for it, and the Vindicator hides inside Starfleet.

incursions.title: Distress call from 52 years ahead

legs.note: a signal and black-box footage come through the wormhole, not a traveler

incursions.summary: After the Protostar's destruction opens a wormhole, Starfleet receives Chakotay's distress call and black-box recordings from Solum 52 years in the future.

incursions.title: Infinity rescue triggers a paradox

legs.note: the Infinity crash-lands
Chakotay and Adreek-Hu escape aboard the ship instead of sending it back empty
the Infinity, rigged as a timeship with an inverse warp field, goes back for Gwyn

incursions.summary: Dal's crew takes the Infinity to 2436 to rescue Chakotay and helps him launch the Protostar. Because he and Adreek ride it into the wormhole rather than sending it empty, the ship never reaches Tars Lamora, and Gwyn starts to fade from existence.
sources: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I (episode)

incursions.title: Protostar sent back to close the loop

legs.note: USS Voyager-A escorts the ship through Asencia's wormhole and beams the crew off
Voyager-A comes back out near Solum

incursions.summary: With the Loom devouring the unraveling timeline, Dal's crew uses Asencia's wormhole generator to send the Protostar back to where they first found it. Dal leaves his combadge on the bridge floor, and the causality loop is closed.

divergences.title: Mirror Universe

branch.cause: parallel universe

divergences.summary: A morally inverted twin of the Prime universe whose people and events shadow their Prime counterparts, ruled for centuries by the brutal Terran Empire. Crossings happen through ion-storm transporter accidents, interphase rifts and, later, deliberate devices, until the two universes drift apart.
keyDifferences: Cochrane's 2063 first contact ends with the Vulcan visitors shot and their ship seized
The Terran Empire rules by terror; Terrans visiting the Prime universe are painfully light-sensitive
After Spock's reforms the Empire falls to a Klingon-Cardassian Alliance; the Terran Rebellion has restored it by 2384
By 3189 the universes have drifted so far apart that no crossing has been recorded for about 500 years
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
divergences.conflict: No divergence point is ever given: shared literature and a Roman-style imperial tradition suggest the split is centuries or millennia old. Span starts at the earliest dated mirror scene (April 2063).

divergences.title: Lazarus's antimatter universe

branch.cause: antimatter counterpart universe linked by a negative magnetic corridor

divergences.summary: A universe made of antimatter that matches ours particle for particle, reached through a negative magnetic corridor built by Lazarus's people. Kirk destroys the corridor's access, sealing the two Lazaruses inside it in endless combat so their meeting cannot annihilate both universes.
keyDifferences: Everything has an antimatter counterpart, including a second Lazarus
Counterparts meeting outside the corridor would destroy both universes
Each passage causes 'winks' that briefly disrupt physical laws

divergences.title: Arret's reverse-time universe

branch.cause: negative universe entered by flying into a supernova at high warp

divergences.summary: Towed through the Beta Niobe supernova by Karla Five's ship, the Enterprise enters a negative universe where time runs backward and its crew start aging toward infancy. Commodore Robert April, the only adult left, takes the ship home, and the transporter restores everyone's ages.
keyDifferences: Time runs backward: people age in reverse and stars collapse instead of exploding
Home of Arret and of Karla Five
Reached and exited through a nova at high warp

divergences.title: Megas-Tu (magic universe)

branch.cause: matter-energy whirlwind at the galactic center, where matter is created

divergences.summary: Probing the galaxy's center, the Enterprise is swept into a universe where magic is a natural law. Its people, the Megans, once lived among humans until persecution at Salem drove them home; Kirk defends Lucien before a Megan tribunal and the ship is sent back.
keyDifferences: Belief and will act as physical forces ('magic')
Creation points link it to our universe at the galactic center
Lucien is remembered on Earth as Lucifer

divergences.title: Fluidic space

branch.cause: dimensional plane filled with fluid, reached through artificial quantum singularities

divergences.summary: A dimension filled with organic fluid instead of vacuum, home of Species 8472. The Borg's attempt to invade it provoked 8472's counter-invasion of the Delta Quadrant, which Voyager's nanoprobe weapon turned back.
keyDifferences: No vacuum: the entire dimension is fluid
Species 8472 resist assimilation and treat all outsiders as threats
A border with our universe exists somewhere in the Beta Quadrant
divergences.conflict: A separate universe rather than a version of Prime history; included because Memory Alpha files it with the parallel universes.

divergences.title: Elysia time trap

branch.cause: small parallel time continuum that touches our universe in the Delta Triangle

divergences.summary: Inside the Delta Triangle lies Elysia, a 'pocket in the garment of time' where nobody ages and wrecks from every era drift. Its council, descended from trapped crews, holds the Enterprise and a Klingon cruiser until the two ships combine power to break out.
keyDifferences: Time does not pass for those inside; ships from many eras, the Bonaventure among them, are trapped
A multi-species council enforces a ban on violence
Collisions between the continua create vortices passable at high warp

divergences.title: The Nexus

branch.cause: realm entered via a temporal flux energy ribbon that crosses the galaxy every 39.1 years

divergences.summary: An extra-dimensional realm, entered by touching the energy ribbon, where time has no meaning and reality reshapes itself around each visitor's wishes. Kirk vanishes into it in 2293 and, with Picard, leaves it in 2371 to return to Veridian III minutes before Soran's launch.
keyDifferences: Visitors live idealized fantasies (Picard's family Christmas, Kirk's mountain home)
A visitor can leave for any time and place in the universe
An 'echo' of Guinan remains inside

divergences.title: Worf's quantum realities

branch.tText: varies (each reality branched at its own point)
branch.cause: Worf's shuttle crosses a quantum fissure; La Forge's VISOR pulses shift him between realities

divergences.summary: Returning from a bat'leth tournament, Worf slides through a series of realities that differ first in trivia and then in history. When the fissure destabilizes, some 285,000 Enterprises from other realities flood the sector, and Worf seals the breach to return home.
keyDifferences: A reality where Worf is married to Troi and Riker captains the Enterprise after Picard's death at the Borg's hands in 2367
A reality where the Borg have overrun the Federation; its Enterprise refuses to return and is destroyed
Smaller differences: cake flavor, crew ranks, a Cardassian attack
Worf's own reality is identified by his quantum signature

divergences.title: Multiverse fissures of 2382

branch.cause: Quantum fissures left behind by the Beagle, an alternate reality's reality-hopping ship

divergences.summary: Through 2382 fissures open across the multiverse: the Cerritos is pulled into a reality 0.327% different, other ships slip through, and a Section 31 crew of 'interdimensional castaways' traces the source to the Beagle, captained by an alternate Lily Sloane. The finale leaves a permanent, guarded portal to the multiverse at Starbase 80.
keyDifferences: 'Dos Cerritos' reality: Beckett Mariner is captain of the Cerritos
Realities with a surviving Enterprise-D and Data, a living Curzon Dax, a Starfleet-surgeon Garak, an EMH Bashir, and a T'Pol married to Trip for 63 years
A reality where Sloane and Cochrane built a quantum reality drive instead of warp drive
A possibility field briefly remaps the Cerritos into other versions, including a Terran Empire ship

divergences.title: Voyager-A split across realities

branch.cause: The Protostar's proto-warp rendezvous tears an interphasic rift through Voyager-A

divergences.summary: Because its crew is bound up in a temporal paradox, the Protostar's arrival splits Voyager-A so that each deck opens onto a different reality. The crew pass through several, including the mirror universe, before a deflector pulse seals the rift.
keyDifferences: A Voyager commanded by Jellico after Janeway died aboard the Infinity
A reality where the living construct destroyed Starfleet
A Voyager crewed by Enderprizians under Captain Tuvix
A mirror-universe Voyager under a Terran Janeway and Chakotay

divergences.title: Anti-time: no life on Earth

branch.cause: An anti-time eruption in the Devron system, created by tachyon pulses from Enterprises in 2364, 2370 and 2395, grows backward through time

divergences.summary: Q's final test shifts Picard among 2364, 2370 and about 2395, where each Enterprise's scan feeds one anomaly that swells as it runs into the past; by 3.5 billion years ago it fills the Alpha Quadrant and stops life forming on Earth. Picard has all three ships seal it with static warp shells, and it never forms.
keyDifferences: Life never arises on Earth, so humanity never exists
The anomaly exists at once in 2364, 2370 and c. 2395
Q frames it as the verdict of the trial begun at Farpoint
divergences.conflict: Deep-time branch point: the front end should clamp or break the axis for t = -3.5e9.

divergences.title: Nazi-occupied America (1944)

branch.cause: An unknown temporal agent assassinates Lenin

divergences.summary: With no Soviet Union, Germany turns west and, helped by the time-traveling Na'kuhl, invades the eastern United States; Enterprise arrives in 1944 New York. Archer stops Vosk's plan to reach the 29th century, the timeline rights itself, and the Temporal Cold War ends.
keyDifferences: Lenin is assassinated in 1916 and the USSR never forms
Germany occupies the eastern US
Vosk's Na'kuhl use the war to build a time conduit home
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha dates the altered 'Temporal War' history 1916 to the 31st century; the span here covers what is shown.

divergences.title: Keeler survives: no Federation

branch.cause: A cordrazine-crazed McCoy leaps through the Guardian of Forever and saves Edith Keeler from a fatal accident

divergences.summary: With Edith Keeler alive, her peace movement delays America's entry into the Second World War, Germany wins it, and the Enterprise and the Federation never come to be. Kirk and Spock follow McCoy into 1930 and Kirk lets Keeler die, restoring history.
keyDifferences: Keeler's pacifist campaign keeps the US out of the war while Germany completes the atomic bomb
Nazi Germany wins the Second World War
No Enterprise or Federation in 2267; only the Guardian's world keeps the original history
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

divergences.title: Starling's 29th-century catastrophe

branch.cause: Braxton's timeship Aeon crashes in 1967 and Henry Starling salvages its technology

divergences.summary: Starling builds Chronowerx and the computer age on 29th-century technology, and his attempt to fly the Aeon to the future destroys the Sol system in the 29th century, the event that sent Braxton back. Voyager destroys the Aeon in 1996, and a Braxton from the unaltered future returns Voyager to 2373.
keyDifferences: The 20th-century microcomputer revolution grows from stolen future technology
A 29th-century temporal explosion destroys the Sol system
Voyager is stranded in 1996 Los Angeles
divergences.conflict: A predestination paradox: how much of Starling's history survives in Prime is left unclear.

divergences.title: 1969 Omaha contamination

branch.cause: The time-displaced Enterprise beams aboard USAF Captain John Christopher, then an air-base sergeant

divergences.summary: Two men from 1969 learn of the Enterprise and the future, threatening history (Christopher's unborn son is due to lead an Earth-Saturn probe). Using the slingshot effect, the crew beam both back into their earlier selves before the encounter.
keyDifferences: Christopher and the sergeant carry knowledge of the 23rd century
Christopher's disappearance would erase his son's place in history

divergences.title: Original 1990s Eugenics Wars

branch.cause: Temporal Wars incursions repeatedly delay the Eugenics Wars
